newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nov 10-day surplus rise due to fewer business days.
newsitem.headline: Nov 10-day surplus rise due to fewer business days.

text.p: The surge in Japan's trade surplus for the first 10 days of November was due to the fact there were only five business days during that period, a Ministry of Finance official said on Monday.
"There were only five business days for this period. The numbers for the early part of the month tend to get skewed easily," the MOF official said.
The Finance Ministry said on Monday that Japan's customs-cleared trade surplus marked a year-on-year increase of 104.4 percent to 202.45 billion yen in the first 10 days of November.
